statement: The control problem for Zielonka automata over distributed alphabets with acyclic architecture is decidable, and a controller can be effectively constructed; the paper states non-elementary complexity in general, EXPTIME at depth 1, and k-EXPTIME at depth k.
complexity_upper: decidable; EXPTIME at depth 1; k-EXPTIME at depth k; non-elementary overall
proof_technique: inductive elimination of a leaf process using covering controllers and r-short automata
